* LLM review says sess is freed on line 415 while the resumed branch still holds it.
* Suggested fix: Move the free in `src/tls_engine.c` below the branch: `free(sess);` goes after the closing brace.
* Add a test to `test/engine_test.c`: resume, then stop, expect no use after free.
